title: VTC Groups — Leave — payload
description: A member leaves a static group, opts out of a dynamic one, or withdraws a pending request to join: renewal of their group credential stops, and what only the group provided is withdrawn. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Leave — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/leave/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/leave/0.1#response.

state.description: `left`: out of a static group. `optedOut`: out of a dynamic group, and kept out whatever its rule says until the member joins again. `requestWithdrawn`: a pending request is withdrawn. `pending`: leaving a group carrying authority, which the community executes as a reduction of the member's own authority on its terms.

credentialValidUntil.description: When the member's last group credential lapses; renewal has stopped. Null when they held none.
